title: 朝日杯FSの後に・熱い期待

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki does great at the Asahi Hai F.S., boosting everyone's expectations of her becoming the next Triple Crown Champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A flood of reporters rush to her for interviews, but she handles them all with practiced ease and coolness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to gain more experience racing in a big event before the Satsuki Sho, so we decide to take on the Yayoi Sho next.
